evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Directive enacts authority-ranking: speaker commands a recurring obligation from a position of rank, not by consensus or exchange.
Cadence specification reinforces the directive's authority-ranking structure — rank-holder sets the operational rhythm.
Self-assignment of ownership enacts authority-ranking from within: the rank-holder takes responsibility for the commanded practice.

mints.name: MandateByAphorism
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here being asserted through an aphoristic maxim that equates non-rehearsal with non-existence, rather than through explicit command language?
